sshrc.publisherMeasure: The data file for SSHRC shows all payments (grants and scholarships/fellowships) in a given fiscal year (April 1st to March 31st); who is awarded (applicant name) and where the money is administered (institution). There is also some additional application information such as title, keywords, discipline, and area of research for each payment.

pubmed.query: "Northern Ontario School of Medicine"[Affiliation] OR "NOSM University"[Affiliation] OR "NOSM"[Affiliation]

FiscalYear_AnneeFinanciere.notes: The Canadian government's fiscal year is from April 1st to March 31st. Fiscal year format: YYYYYY (e.g. 202324 for 2023-24).

InstitutionPaidCode_CodeEtablissementPay.definition: The institution paid’s four-letter institution code. The code is the institution's unique identifier.
InstitutionPaidCode_CodeEtablissementPay.notes: In cases where an award was paid directly to an individual or paid to an organization outside Canada that is unspecified, the code possibilities are one of “ZXXX, ZXXA, ZXXB.” In cases where the award was paid to an organization inside Canada that is unspecified, the Research Institution code is provided as the Institution Paid code as well.

AmountPaidFY_MontantPayeAF.definition:
Total amount paid for the grant or award in the current fiscal year. The amount is specific to a funding reference number (FRN) and the institution paid. In the event where a grant switches the institutions paid, the FRN and application information will appear on multiple rows for the same fiscal year. 

All CIHR funding and partner funding that is administered by CIHR is included. Partner funding that is administered independently from CIHR is excluded.
AmountPaidFY_MontantPayeAF.notes:
In the Q1-Q3 updates, this field will only report the expected amount to be paid in the current fiscal year. Expected amounts may be subject to change. In the Q4 (i.e. full fiscal year dataset) update, this field will provide the total amount paid during that fiscal year.

CIHR funding for new awards obtained through the Canada Research Chairs Program is included in the full fiscal year dataset only. 

Quarters correspond to:
Q1 (April 1-June 30)
Q2 (July 1-September 30)
Q3 (October 1-December 31)
Q4 (January 1-March 31)

TotalAmountPaid_MontantTotalPaye.definition:
Total amount paid for the grant or award up to the current fiscal year. The amount is specific to a funding reference number (FRN) and the institution paid. This is an expected value and may be subject to change. 

All CIHR funding and partner funding that is administered by CIHR is included. Partner funding that is administered independently from CIHR is excluded.
TotalAmountPaid_MontantTotalPaye.notes:
In the Q1-Q3 updates, this field will report the amount paid up to but not including the current fiscal year. In the Q4 (i.e. full fiscal year dataset) update, this field will include the amount paid from that fiscal year, and previous years.

CIHR funding for new awards obtained through the Canada Research Chairs Program is included in the full fiscal year dataset only. 

Quarters correspond to:
Q1 (April 1-June 30)
Q2 (July 1-September 30)
Q3 (October 1-December 31)
Q4 (January 1-March 31)

TotalAmountAwarded_MontantTotalAccorde.definition:
Total amount awarded for the grant or award overall. The amount is specific to a funding reference number (FRN) and the institution paid. This is an expected value and may be subject to change. 

All CIHR funding and partner funding that is administered by CIHR is included. Partner funding that is administered independently from CIHR is excluded.
TotalAmountAwarded_MontantTotalAccorde.notes:
CIHR funding for new awards obtained through the Canada Research Chairs Program is included in the full fiscal year dataset only. 

Quarters correspond to:
Q1 (April 1-June 30)
Q2 (July 1-September 30)
Q3 (October 1-December 31)
Q4 (January 1-March 31)

cihrExpectationReview.reason: Every AmountPaidFY_MontantPayeAF source value is blank. The Q1–Q3 dictionary defines expected fiscal-year amounts, but this collected workbook contains none. TotalAmountPaid and TotalAmountAwarded are different measures and are not substituted; no amounts are converted to zero or inferred.

geography: Reviewed campus points locate whole-institution records for context. No amount, work count or infrastructure project is allocated to that campus, nearby residents, a health area, a future NHHR building or a specific facility.
privacy: Only allowlisted scientific/public institutional fields; no personal names, contacts, participants, directors, consent or remuneration records.
qualityFindings: C056 Northern Health candidate is Northern Norway Regional Health Authority; excluded.
SSHRC FY2024 file has 15 FY2022 rows excluded; split institution amounts retained.
PubMed 20-ID samples are not query totals; response has no capture timestamp.
CFI has no stable project-ID column; counts are source project records.
OpenAlex 2021–2025 overlap in the 2016–2025 extension does not create extra independent observations.
C054 Q3 dictionary defines expected fiscal-year payments, but all 7309 expected-amount cells are blank; no amount view is released.
